description_en: Query all permission application orders where the current user is an approver or stakeholder
description_zh: 查询当前用户作为审批人或相关方的所有权限申请单
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-my-related-approvals --def-schema MaxCompute --resource-type project --resource '{"DefSchema":"MaxCompute","DefVersion":"v1.0.0","MetaData":{"key":"example-string"}}' --start-time 1771948800000 --end-time 1779724799999 --statuses Deleted --grantee PrincipalId=ROLE_3133343434 PrincipalType=RamRole --access-types select --next-token eyJpZCI6MTIzfQ== --page-size 20 --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou

parameters.help_en:
Filter by approval status. Enum values:

WaitApproval: Pending approval
Confirmed: Pending authorization
RejectApproval: Approval rejected
AuthorizeSucceed: Authorization succeeded
AuthorizeFailed: Authorization failed
Deleted: Deleted
Canceled: Withdrawn
parameters.help_zh:
审批状态筛选。枚举：

WaitApproval 待审批
Confirmed 待授权
RejectApproval 审批拒绝
AuthorizeSucceed 授权成功
AuthorizeFailed 授权失败
Deleted 已删除
Canceled 已撤回
parameters.name: statuses

fields.help_en:
Authorization principal ID:

`RamUser`: Dataworks UserId
`RamRole`: Dataworks UserId prefixed with "ROLE_"
`DataworksTenantMember`: Dataworks UserId
`DataworksTenantRole`: Dataworks tenant roleCode
`DataworksProjectRole`: Dataworks workspace roleCode
`DataworksProjectMember`: Dataworks UserId
`DlfRole`: DlfNext role name
